data: Book TitleAuthorDescriptionDark MirrorBart GellmanPulitzer Prize and Emmy Award-winning journalist, Bart Gellman's fascinating account of being the first to communicate with Snowden and reporting on the 2013 disclosures. Detailed insights into NSA, archive protection, nation-state hacking attempts, OpSec, and more.Permanent RecordEdward SnowdenEdward Snowden's must-read memoir offering insights into his experiences.Tor: Darknet Bundle (5 in 1)Lance HendersonA comprehensive guide by Lance Henderson covering OpSec, privacy, and specifics like booting Tails or configuring Firefox in the Tor darknet.We Have RootBruce SchneierBruce Schneier's collection of essays on cybersecurity, privacy, and security, providing valuable insights to dip in and out of.Open Source Intelligence TechniquesMichael BazzellMichael Bazzell's book on OSINT methodology, guiding readers from setting up a virtual environment to advanced command line tools and reporting techniques. Includes useful tools.The Art of InvisibilityKevin MitnickKevin Mitnick's how-to guide on privacy and security, narrated through real-world stories, making it a must-read.Cult of the Dead CowJoseph MennJoseph Menn's excellent book on one of the most infamous hacking groups, offering valuable insight into the history and roots of hacking culture.Hands On HackingMatthew HickeyMatthew Hickey's wide-ranging and technical book crash-course on hacking, covering ethics, law, and various technical guides.A Hacker's ManifestoMcKenzie WarkMcKenzie Wark's philosophically rich book on hacker culture and ideology, deemed a must-read.2600 MagazineN/A (Collective)The OG hacker quarterly, a must-read for anyone interested in hacker culture.SmartcutsShane SnowShane Snow's book on how hackers, innovators, and icons accelerate success, offering insights on thinking like a hacker.Cypherpunks: Cyber FreedomTimothy LearyTimothy Leary's unique book providing a philosophical take on questioning authority, thinking for oneself, and rebooting the brain.Steal This Computer BookWallace WangWallace Wang's dated but still valuable look into computer book stealing.Digital GoldNathaniel PopperNathaniel Popper's excellent story on the history of Bitcoin and the misfits and millionaires trying to reinvent money.Obfuscation: A User's GuideFinn Brunton & Helen NissenbaumFinn Brunton & Helen Nissenbaum's excellent 100-page book from MIT Press focusing on privacy and protest through obfuscation.
